response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced senior engineer with strong full-stack, testing, and mentoring credentials, but falls well short of the core minimum qualifications for this role. C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments plus a thesis project, versus the required 8 years, and most large-scale systems work is in DLang/Node.js rather than cloud compute platform infrastructure. There is also no formal technical-leadership experience managing cross-team priorities and deliverables at the scale this role demands.
strengths: High-throughput distributed systems experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec in low-latency DLang services at Sociomantic)
Strong testing culture and mentoring track record (TDD, workshops, courses, open-source test frameworks)
Broad 15+ year engineering background with cloud tooling exposure (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD)
concerns: Far below the required 8 years of C++ experience; primary languages are TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang
No formal technical-lead or people-leadership role owning strategy, priorities, and cross-team alignment
Limited depth in cloud compute platform architecture; recent work is product-focused full-stack development

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal technical leadership experience
